Commentary.Commentary: The hosts were not fully able to recover after that and Jasprit Bumrah picked up three cheap wickets in his last over. The damage was done though, with the Windies scoring their highest ever T20I score and setting a massive 246 run target for India. A slight cause of worry is the intermittent drizzle and the showers it might foreshadow. Join us shortly for what has the potential to be an epic run chase!

Not missing a beat, Lewis picked up steam to blast his way to a maiden T20I century. Ravichandran Ashwin did his best to slow the batsmen down and did a fair job, being the only bowler to keep his economy rate in the single digits. However, the visitors only made a real breakthrough in Ravindra Jadeja's over. Amidst a furiously chanting crowd, the second spinner picked up the scalp of Andre Russell and followed it up with the big wicket of Lewis.

What a brilliant innings it has been for West Indies! From the moment they stepped out, they showed that they meant business. Johnson Charles and Evin Lewis utterly dominated the bowlers in an indiscriminate show of power. The people in the stands cowered as the pair rained boundaries on them but Mohammed Shami managed to put a dent into the hosts' side when he removed the more active Charles.
No, hat-trick for Bumrah! Full ball on middle and leg, Samuels plays it to mid-wicket for a single. With that the greatest of innings of WEST INDIES FINISH ON 245/6!
Marlon Samuels is the last man in.
OUT! Another one for Bumrah! Yorker ball on off, Simmons tries to loft that up over covers but is undone by the pace. He is bowled by that fine ball. Bumrah is on a hat-trick!!!
Lendl Simmons is the next batsman in.

OUT! Pollard departs! Full toss on the stumps, Pollard goes across and tries to scoop it over short third man but misses the line of the ball completely. Good bowling there by Bumrah as he gets his man.
Low full toss on off, played to third man for a single.
Full ball on off, pushed through mid off for a single. Good bowling by the young lad.
SIX! Short ball on middle and leg, Pollard pulls it away through mid-wicket for a maximum. He can play such shots all day long.
Dwayne Bravo is the new man in.
Free Hit is coming up.

OUT! Full ball on middle and off, Pollard plays it back to Bumrah and he is his followthrough grabs it and throws it at the non-striker's end. Jasprit is delighted, he knows that Brathwaite is out of his crease. The replays show the same. Good awareness there by the bowler. No ball is given too.
Off cutter outside off, Carlos goes for a wild swing but misses.
Full ball on off, Pollard tries to pull it but it goes off the toe end towards Dhoni for a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Full ball outside off, Pollard gets across and glances it off his hips over mid-wicket for a biggie. Another big shot in that mid-wicket stand.
Wide! Kumar hurls it too wide outside off, Pollard goes after it but still cannot make any connection. Wide is given as it was too wide.
Length ball on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Full ball wide outside off, Brathwaite tries to go big but misses the line of the ball.
High full toss outside off, Pollard looks to drill it away but it goes off the top edge through covers for a single.
Full ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite tries to drill it away but it goes on to hit the pads off an inside edge. Brilliant over there by Bumrah.
Full ball on the pads, it goes off the inside edge back to the keeper. Dhoni does well to stop the ball as it was racing away to the fence. Single taken.
Yorker on the pads, Pollard tries to flick it away but it goes back to the keeper.
Full toss on off, driven to covers for a single.
FOUR! Utilized to the core! Full toss outside off, all Carlos had to do is put it in the gaps. He does it so well by placing it over backward point for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Low full on the pads, Pollard plays it to short fine leg for a single. No ball has been signaled.
Serves it full on middle and leg, pushed to mid-wicket for a brace.
Jaspreet Bumrah comes into the attack.
Perfect ball on middle and leg, driven to mid off for a single.
Fuller ball on off, lofted over covers for a single.
Full and wide outside off, a play and a miss.
SIX! Remember the name! Full ball outside off, width on offer. The captain pulls it with authority over mid-wicket for a big, big maximum. Great connection there.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, cut to point for a single.
Full ball outside off, a play and a miss. Good over that for India.
Carlos Brathwaite is the new man in.

OUT! The centurion departs! Serves it  outside off, Lewis off his back foot looks to play a glam shot but miscues it. The ball balloons over the cover. Ashwin goes back and takes a good running catch. So, after the run out appeal, the catch has been taken. Lewis has to go after that glorious innings. Good comeback by India. Now, two new batsmen at the crease.
Not out! On middle and leg, Pollard nudges it to short leg. They cross for a run but the direct is scored at the striker's end. The replays show that the southpaw was well in. Single taken.
The umpire has referred a run out appeal against Lewis upstairs.
Kieron Pollard is the next batsman in.

OUT! Russell departs! Darts it full around middle and off, it skids after pitching. Russell off his back foot tries to block it but is undone. The ball hits the pads, the roaring appeals are out. The umpire raises his dreaded finger. Jadeja gets his man and the stand of 78 runs is broken. Good cameo of Andre Russell is over, well played though.
FOUR! Punished! Tad short wide outside off, Russell slams it to deep cover for a boundary. Partnership blooming.
Maiden T20I century for Evin Lewis.
Darts it outside off, Lewis goes back and cuts it through point for a single. What an innings. With that 200 is also up.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Similar line outside off, Andre plays it to covers. 15 overs and the score is 199/1!
Hurls it too wide yet again. Russell tries to squeeze it but gets an inside edge on the bounce to the keeper. Good bowling that.
Wide! Too full and wide outside off, Russell looks to play at it but misses. However, the umpire calls it a wide.
Hurls it on the pads, nudged to fine leg for a single.
Full ball on off, cut to point for a single.
SIX! Powered! Tad short on middle and leg, Andre Russell latches into it and pulls it with power through mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Full ball on middle and leg, Lewis flicks it to short third man for a single.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Serves it on off, steered to third man for a single.
Short ball on off, played to the off side.
SIX! Serves it on the pads. Lewis goes down on the knees and tries to sweep it. The ball goes off the top edge into the deep square leg stand for a maximum. Everything is going into the stand today.
Floats it up outside off, Lewis looks to push it through covers but misses.
Serves it outside off, a play and a miss.
Tossed up ball on off, swept to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, it is played to the off side for a single.
SIX! Russell joins the party now! Short ball on off, Andre pulls it with utmost power through mid-wicket for a maximum.
Tossed up ball on off, Lewis looks to play it on the on side but it goes off the inside edge. Single taken.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Lewis squeezes it through backward point for a well-placed boundary. Cannot stop the carnage of runs here. Any bowler result is same.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Lewis cannot reach out to it. The umpire doesn't call it as a wide.
Length ball on the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes into the attack.
Bowls it quicker through the air outside off, Ewin is beaten on that ball. A very good over from Ashwin here.
On the pads, worked to fine leg for a single.
Serves it on middle and leg, swept to the leg side for a single.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, a play and a miss.
Floats it up on off, defended neatly.
Serves it full outside off, Lewis cuts it. The ball goes through backward point for a brace.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
There is a steady drizzle that doesn't show any times of stopping.
No, he cannot! Short ball outside off, Lewis pulls it but it dies in the deep. Single taken. 33 runs off that over.
SIX! Fifth one! Bouncer ball on middle and leg, Lewis pulls it and the ball goes into the long leg stand for a maximum. Can he hit six sixes in the over?
SIX! Another one! Short ball wide outside off, Lewis walks across and lofts it over covers for a maximum. Fourth biggie in the over.
SIX! Third biggie of the over! Full toss ball on off, Lewis stays deep in his crease and plays it over covers for a maximum. He is a powerhouse and for sure the audience isn't missing Chris Gayle.
Wide! Too full and wide outside off, left alone and wide is given.
SIX! Two in two! Hurls it full on middle and off, Lewis hits it downtown for another maximum. He is looking lethal and unstoppable.
SIX! The action continues! Bowls it short around middle and leg, Lewis hammers it to deep mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Stuart Binny comes into the attack!
Back of a length ball on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Maiden T20I fifty for Evin Lewis.
FOUR! Squeezed away! Full ball outside off, Lewis puts his bat to it and the ball goes through backward point for a racy boundary.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Andre Russell is the next man in.

OUT! Shami draws first blood! Bowls it full toss around off. Charles goes across and tries to scoop it to the leg side. The ball goes between bat and pad and hits the woodwork. The dangerman has departed and Shami brings the good news. What an innings from Charles, he has literally tore apart the Indian bowling. A good infact brilliant opening stand is broken. Well played Johnson.
Back of a length ball on off, cut to point for a single.
FOUR! Full ball on middle and off, Lewis looks to go hard at it but it goes off the outside edge over slip cordon for a welcome boundary.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
SIX! What a way to end the over! Tossed up around off, Charles insults the bowler. He lofts it up and over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Floats it up on middle and leg, negotiated to mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball on off, worked to mid on for a single.
Serves it short outside off, Charles off his back foot punches it to point. The fielder fumbles and brace is taken.
SIX! Massive! Serves in on middle and leg, Charles kneels down and slog sweeps it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a big, big six. That is into the orbit perhaps.
FOUR! Darts it short around off and it is pulled away through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Bowls it short on off, pulled to the leg side for a single.
Serves it full and it is defended neatly.
Short ball outside off, a back foot punch through point for a brace.
Off-spinning ball on off, a play and a miss there.
SIX! Mistimed but doesn't matter! Floats it up on off, Charles kneels and slogs it. The ball goes off the top edge and into long on for another maximum. It is raining sixes here. Watch out Florida.
Floats it up on off, driven to mid off for a run.
Floats it on off, Charles pushes it to covers for no runs.
Fuller on off, pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
Darts it outside off, a play and a miss.
On the pads, played to mid-wicket.
SIX! Punished! Serves another short ball outside off, Lewis goes back and sends it soaring deep into the mid-wicket stand for another biggie.
SIX! Lewis hits it this time! Short ball outside off, ample amount of time and Lewis slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Biggie on the first ball of the over.
Ravindra Jadeja to bowl.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, mistimed to the leg side. End of an over.
4th T20I fifty for Johnson Charles.
SIX! Whattey shot!  Serves it fuller on middle and leg, Charles pulls it yet again through mid-wicket for back-to-back biggies. That brings up his fifty too.
SIX! Charles goes aerial yet again! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Charles from his crease drills it over long on for a maximum. What a shot there by Charles. He is nearing his fifty.
Ashwin around the wicket floats it on middle and leg, Lewis flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Leg-spinning delivery on middle and leg, Charles plays it with soft hands to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around off, Charles drills it to mid on.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl next.
A good yorker on middle and leg, Charles does well to play it to the leg side for a single.

SIX! Disappered! Short ball outside off, a bit slow too. Charles clears his left leg and hammers it into the stands at mid-wicket for a maximum. He is on a roll and setting Florida high with his power-strokes.
Tad full on the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, steered to third man for a single.
FOUR! Bumrah from around the wicket, bowls a short ball outside off, Lewis plays it with disdain over covers for a boundary. What striking here.

SIX! Clobbered! Pitched up outside off, width on offer. Lewis had all the time in the world to dispatch that into the stands. He lofts it neatly over wide of long off for a biggie. 50 up for West Indies.
Short ball on middle and leg, awkwardly pulled to fine leg for a brace. Good, good over that.
FOUR! Two in two! Bowls it on middle and leg, Charles waits for it and paddles it through square leg for another boundary. Great placement by the West Indies opener.
FOUR! Unusual shot! Full ball outside off, Charles sees it and  plays it deliberately to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller ball on off, pulled to the leg side for a single.
Bouncer on middle and leg, the southpaw rides the bounce well over long leg for another brace. Good positive intent here by him. Runs coming thick and fast.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Lewis off his back foot tries to pull it but gets beaten on his pads.
Tad full on the sixth stump line, Charles looks to slam that but misses the line of the ball completely.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off for a single. KL Rahul does well to stop that ball.
Back of a length ball outside off, Lewis stays back and cuts it through backward point for a brace. Good cricket here by Lewis, got a four then dealing in twos now.
FOUR! Pulled away! Slow ball outside off, Lewis senses it too early and waits forever to pull it into the gap of square leg for a rocketed boundary.
Short ball outside off, Lewis pulls it awkwardly from outside off just over mid off for a brace. Windies are scoring at a good rate.
Full ball on off, angling away from the batsman, Lewis gets to the ball and blocks it.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl next.
Back of a length ball outside off, width on offer. Charles gets back and plays it softly through covers for a brace.
Bowls it full outside off, Charles looks to play it on the off side but misses.

FOUR! Edged and runs! A good length ball outside off, Charles shimmies to the pitch of the ball and looks to loft it but the ball catches a thick outside edge and goes into the third man stand for another boundary. Runs flowing here.
Perfect length ball on middle and leg, it angles in after pitching. Charles gets back to play it on the leg side but gets cramped and the ball hits him on his thigh pad.
Back of a length ball outside off, Lewis cuts it late through cover-point for a single.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Lewis leaves it for the keeper.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Another pull! Short ball on middle and leg, Charles pulls it with high might through deep square leg for one more boundary. Expensive over that.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, pushed to the on side for a single.
Length ball on off, steered to third man for a single. Good cricket here.
FOUR! On the leg side! Fuller on middle and leg, Charles flicks it over mid-wicket for a racy boudnary. Attacking intent here from the Caribbean opener.
SIX! Downtown! Full ball on off, Johnson sees it early and launches it straight down the ground for the first maximum of this match. This shot is talking lot of the track, expect lots of runs folks.
Full ball outside off, Johnson looks at it and lets it through to the keeper.
Wide! Shami starts with a wide. Hurls a length ball down the leg side, Johson lets it through and the umpire signals it as a wide. Off the mark Windies.

Here we are for the first T20I as the national anthems are done and dusted. The two Windies players are out in the middle. Johnson Charles and Evin Lewis are at the crease. Mohammed Shami will bowl first up. Here we go, Florida...

Carlos Brathwaite, West Indies skipper says that they will continue to play from where they left. (On the support) He states that it is great to see such crowd coming to cheer and it will be fascinating to play. Ends by saying that Chris Gayle and Jason Holder won't be playing today because of injuries.

MS Dhoni, Indian skipper says that they will bowl first. It is always good the days they get and made good use of it. Only he and Jasprit were traveling form India and they got good time to practice. (On West Indies) He feels that they are a good side and it will be a challenging side to play and will look forward to get into the groove of T20I. (About Windies in Cpl) They have benefited from it. (On playing here) He opines that it is a great venue to play at it and will be a great time playing here.
TOSS - India win the toss and elect to bowl first.

Pitch report - Ian Bishop reckons that the climate looks good as of now and will allow a good game of cricket. He also says that the average score looks like a  170. He believes that the ball will come onto bat and it will be a fantastic track to bat on.

Windies, on the other hand, will be under the leadership of  Carlos Brathwaite, the champion of champions who got them the T20I WC this year. The return of powerhouses like Gayle, Pollard, Bravo will be a sight to witness too. The weather looks bright and sunny. Stay with us as toss coming up next.

MS Dhoni will be back in action after a long time and it will be interesting to see how he goes about this game. There are superstar batsmen like Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli who will like to swing their bat as hard as they can since it is USA.

Hello and a warm welcome to all the cricket lovers, it is India versus West Indies at Florida for the first T20I. The atmosphere is electrifying and the visitors are all ready to see this fascinating contest of bat and ball.
